invariants.statement: A model point is excluded at 95% confidence level when its observed CLs is below 0.05.
invariants.citation: A. L. Read, J. Phys. G 28 (2002) 2693; T. Junk, Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 434 (1999) 435

invariants.statement: An exclusion result is never reported as a discovery claim.
Efficiencies, likelihoods, covariances and k-factors come from declared sources with provenance.
Blinded signal-region data is never presented before an authorized unblinding.
No event generation, including a smoke run, runs before the CHECK-IN 1 approval.
At most one native scientific job runs on a machine at a time.
A gate acts only on bytes whose digest equals the authorized action digest.
invariants.enforced_by: rdj receipt check at the gate
